For \(n=1,\dots,24\), \(\sin(n\pi/25)>0\), so \(S_n>0\).  
At \(n=25\), \(a_{25}=0\), so \(S_{25}=S_{24}>0\).

For \(n=26,\dots,49\), \(a_n<0\), so \(S_n\) decreases. Pair terms:
\[
a_k+a_{50-k}
=\sin\frac{k\pi}{25}\left(\frac1k-\frac1{50-k}\right)>0
\]
for \(k=1,\dots,24\). Thus
\[
S_{49}=\sum_{k=1}^{24}(a_k+a_{50-k})+a_{25}>0.
\]
Since \(S_n\) decreases on \(26,\dots,49\), all \(S_{26},\dots,S_{49}>0\). Also \(a_{50}=0\), so \(S_{50}=S_{49}>0\).

Therefore all 50 are positive.

\[
\boxed{50}
\]
